name: Battleship
tagline: Classic Battleship against a smart computer, from one tested Java engine
summary: A 2022 Java Swing stub that only asked for a name is rebuilt as a full game of Battleship against the computer. One tested Java 25 engine plays it in the terminal and, compiled to JavaScript with TeaVM, behind a mobile-first React app designed in Figma on Material 3.
highlights: One Java engine, with immutable game state, plays the same game in the terminal and in the browser
A computer opponent that hunts on a spaced pattern and follows a line after a hit, in under 70 shots on average
The old program's behaviour was pinned by tests first, then its bugs were fixed one commit at a time
Every screen designed in Figma first, at phone, tablet and desktop widths, in light and dark
Aim-then-fire on touch, full keyboard play and screen-reader announcements for every shot
